input: Make a personalized family recipe book as a gift

gold.taskTitle: Create a Personalized Family Recipe Book Gift
gold.taskDescription: Plan and produce a personalized family recipe book to give as a meaningful gift to someone special.

questions.title: Who is the recipe book being made for?
questions.description: Identify the specific recipient of the gift so the content and tone can be tailored appropriately.

questions.title: Which family members' recipes should be included?
questions.description: Determine whose recipes will be collected — just one side of the family, both sides, specific relatives, etc.

questions.title: How many recipes are you aiming to include?
questions.description: Establish a target number of recipes to set the scope and size of the book.

questions.title: What is the occasion or deadline for this gift?
questions.description: Find out when the book needs to be ready, such as a birthday, holiday, or anniversary date.

questions.title: Do you want a physical printed book or a digital one?
questions.description: Clarify the final format of the recipe book to guide the production method and tools needed.

questions.title: Will you gather the recipes yourself or ask relatives?
questions.description: Determine how the recipes will be sourced — self-collected, crowdsourced from family, or a mix of both.

questions.title: Should the book include photos, stories, or just recipes?
questions.description: Understand what extra personal touches the user wants to include beyond the recipes themselves.
